card.name: US place names before local institutions
card.fires_on: Place-name words in US local news, such as County or Georgia, that follow a county or region name and come before a school, health or railroad institution.

modes.label: County after a name
modes.description: The word County right after a US county name, before schools or students.
modes.example: Burke<< County>> schools are preparing for a curriculum change coming

modes.label: Inside regional institution names
modes.description: A region or name word inside the name of a regional organization or school.
modes.example: Dr. Denny Carter, an orthopedic surgeon at Southeast<< Georgia>> Health System in Brunswick

card.writes: It seems to push toward place-name continuations and proper-noun pieces, with no clear everyday meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on US place names, especially the word County, when a local school or health system is being named.
